simple.summary: בַּעַל תָּמָר (Baʻal Tâmâr) means Baal-Tamar , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Judg 20 33.

definitions.full: H1193. Baal Tamar תָּמָר בַּ֫עַל proper name, of a location ( possessor of palms ; or Baal of Tamar ? ) Judg 20:33 , near Gibeah.
